answer: Ten fakes cannot share one pair of hands. The jetty opens 36 moorings an epoch: each identity docks, plants a garden and tends it all epoch — four waterings in one shared 20-minute window, seeded by a dune wind drawn at docking. One operator tends at most two plots live, so ten fakes take five operators, forty waterings a window. Bonds start at 120 POA and rise 45 per extra identity from the same root, so ten linked fakes lock 3,225 POA; a missed window burns 25 POA per plot. The ledger checks watering timestamps against funding roots: plots watered in the same minute by one hand count as one.
